unit.why: A quotation from Siddur Lev Sameah on reciting Ahavah Rabbah with intention to hasten the Messiah. Its only narrative element is a one-line citation that an anonymous tzaddik was told this in a dream, which serves as a proof-text, not a story.
unit.boundary_note: division ends with the section-closing formula for letter mem and the heading of letter nun; the next division begins the Noam Elimelekh material
